requestProjection.scope: Only the obsolete private record constructor and required macro imports change. Original normal/abnormal target creation, joins, low-level lock lease checks and thread-state assertions remain byte-exact. No runtime fallback or input refusal.

controlRefinement.protocol: Target waits after its original work, before completion. Driver keeps both original interrupt calls and all original work; after the original handler observation loop it sends finish and joins. Original final value and tail-exception assertions remain. No amount of computation promises another thread remains alive.
